newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania sees higher economic growth in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Romania sees higher economic growth in 1997.

text.p: Romania's economy is expected to expand by 5.5 percent in 1997, up from a forecasted 4.8 percent this year, the National Forecasting Board (CNP) said.
"The projected growth of gross domestic product (GDP) is 5.5 percent for next year," CNP manager Petrica Grama told Reuters on Monday.

In August Romania said the 1996 GDP would rise by 4.8 percent, revising a previous estimate of 4.5 percent. Last year Romania's economy expanded by 6.9 percent, up from 3.9 in 1994. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
